metadata.notes: Demo ruleset for OpenBenefits – not official government data.

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Central Sector)
schemes.description: This scheme provides financial aid to students from Scheduled Caste communities to pursue higher education after Class 10.

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
schemes.description: A merit-based scholarship for Class 8 students from economically weaker sections to encourage them to complete secondary education.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) – Short Term Training
schemes.description: This program offers free, industry-relevant skill training to help Indian youth secure better livelihoods through certified job roles.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.description: A social security scheme providing a monthly pension to elderly citizens living below the poverty line.

schemes.name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: An income support scheme that provides financial assistance to farmer families to manage agricultural and domestic expenses.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
schemes.description: The world's largest health assurance scheme providing ₹5 lakh annual health cover for secondary and tertiary care to poor and vulnerable families.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.description: A small savings scheme for the girl child to build a fund for her future education and marriage expenses.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.description: A guaranteed pension scheme for citizens in the unorganized sector, providing a monthly pension after age 60.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance to rural households living in dilapidated or kutcha houses to build permanent pucca homes.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
schemes.description: Supports urban families in acquiring or building affordable permanent houses through interest subsidies and financial aid.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.description: Provides farmers with timely credit for cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and investment in agriculture-allied activities.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.description: A cash incentive scheme for pregnant women and lactating mothers to improve health and compensate for wage loss during their first pregnancy.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme
schemes.description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to SC, ST, and women entrepreneurs for starting new greenfield businesses.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
schemes.description: Provides a monthly pension to widows aged 40 and above who belong to families living below the poverty line.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance to persons with severe or multiple disabilities aged 18 and above from BPL households.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM)
schemes.description: A voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganized workers to ensure old age financial security.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.description: A low-cost accidental insurance scheme offering coverage for death and disability to all savings bank account holders.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.description: A renewable life insurance scheme offering ₹2 lakh coverage for death due to any cause at an affordable premium.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.description: A micro-credit facility for street vendors to access collateral-free working capital loans to restart their livelihoods.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Mandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
schemes.description: A pension scheme for small and marginal farmers providing a monthly pension of ₹3,000 after they reach age 60.

schemes.name: Scheme For Residential Education For Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA)
schemes.description: Provides high-quality residential education to meritorious SC students in private schools to ensure overall development.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH) Yojana
schemes.description: A multi-pronged skill development scheme for marginalized sections to increase their employability and earning potential.

schemes.name: National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance to SC students pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D. degrees in Indian universities.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
schemes.description: Provides scholarships to students from Other Backward Classes pursuing post-secondary studies to reduce dropout rates.

schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
schemes.description: Financial support for SC students in Classes 9 and 10 to help them stay in school and prepare for higher education.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.description: Supports traditional artisans and craftspeople through skill training, toolkit incentives, and collateral-free credit support.

schemes.name: One Stop Centre Scheme
schemes.description: Provides integrated support and assistance under one roof to women affected by violence, both in private and public spaces.

schemes.name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
schemes.description: A campaign to generate awareness and improve the efficiency of welfare services intended for girls in India.

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises
schemes.description: Enables MSEs to access credit from financial institutions without the need for third-party guarantees or collateral.

schemes.name: PM POSHAN (Mid Day Meal Scheme)
schemes.description: Provides one hot cooked meal to school-going children to improve nutritional status and encourage school attendance.

schemes.name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
schemes.description: Provides a lump sum grant to BPL households upon the death of the primary breadwinner between ages 18-59.

schemes.name: Annapurna Scheme
schemes.description: Provides 10 kg of free food grains per month to senior citizens who are eligible for but not receiving old age pensions.

schemes.name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
schemes.description: Organizes the rural poor into Self Help Groups (SHGs) and provides them with sustainable livelihood opportunities and financial aid.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
schemes.description: Provides clean cooking fuel (LPG connections) to women from BPL households to improve health and reduce indoor pollution.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.description: Provides loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises for income-generating activities.
